subject: StratusGrid pilot: pricing proposal & forecast status
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: StratusGrid: proposed 30% pilot discount - need finance signoff

Hi team,

Quick summary on StratusGrid (large prospect, energy ops): the AE is proposing a 12-month pilot at 30% off list to get them live and get product feedback. They want to start in July and have asked for an invoice/PO in July.

Why this matters for forecast: at 30% the ARR delta vs list would move $150k from best-case into potential committed ARR impact if we mark it as committed for July. Finance is asking whether we should treat this as a committed deal or leave it as best-case until PO + signed SOW.

Attachments: pricing_summary.xlsx (proposed terms), StratusGrid_SOW_v2.pdf (redline from AE)

Ask: Hannah — can you confirm whether we should:
- mark this as committed for the July commit (would increase committed ARR by $150k), or
- keep as best-case / pending until signed SOW + PO?

Karthik — deal desk input on discount governance (30% pilot vs gated 20-25%) would be helpful.
Laura — any revenue recognition or billing concerns if we move forward with pilot pricing and bill in July?

Thanks,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StratusGrid: proposed 30% pilot discount - need finance signoff

Thanks Vanessa — quick clarifying Qs before I weigh in:

- Is the 30% itemized across seat/license and implementation or a blanket concession? The SOW redline looked like a blended concession.
- Is the pilot tied to a mandatory renewal at list after 12 months or is there a step-up clause?

For forecasting: my inclination is to not move to "committed" until we have both a signed SOW and an issued PO. If procurement sends a PO this week, we can consider committing for July revenue, otherwise keep as best-case.

Karthik — can Deal Desk prioritize a quick adjudication (ideally by EOD tomorrow) on whether a 25% pilot is acceptable as an approved concession or if we must reduce to 20%?

Laura — please flag any billing recognition constraints for a mid-month pilot start.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StratusGrid: proposed 30% pilot discount - need finance signoff

Hannah / Vanessa — looping Deal Desk summary:

- Deal ID: DL-2027-089
- Recommendation: approve a time-boxed pilot discount of 25% (not the full 30%). 25% is boundary-approvable by Deal Desk for strategic pilots with a signed success criteria addendum.
- Governance: require a documented pilot success metric and a hard renewal cadence (option to auto-renew at list price after 12 months unless an authorized commercial amendment is signed).

Implication for forecast: Deal Desk recommends we do NOT mark this as committed until the signed SOW + PO are received. We should keep it in "best case" / commit_pending. If procurement provides a PO and the SOW is countersigned, Deal Desk will retroactively authorize the 25% pilot concession and we can flip to committed in the next forecast cut.

I attached the pricing_summary.xlsx with the 25% alternative and a short AM/AE playbook for the pilot.

If Finance (Laura) says the accounting treatment allows recognition once we invoice against a PO, we can consider moving, but that needs to be explicit.

From: Elaine Park <elaine@ledgerone.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stratusgrid.com>, LedgerOne Sales Ops <salesops@ledgerone.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StratusGrid: proposed 30% pilot discount - need finance signoff

Hi Hannah / Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the quick coordination. We reviewed internally and can accept a 25% pilot concession (with documented success metrics). I've attached the SOW with our procurement redlines — highlights: pilot duration 12 months, PO to be issued within 10 business days of countersignature, and a clause that calls out a renewal discussion 30 days prior to pilot expiration.

We will send a formal PO once the final SOW is countersigned. Would it be possible to get a billing contact so finance can route the PO?

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Procurement Manager, StratusGrid

Attachment: StratusGrid_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@ledgerone.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StratusGrid: proposed 30% pilot discount - need finance signoff

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps so Forecast / Finance have clarity: 

1) Discount: Deal Desk approved 25% pilot (Karthik) — AE will update SOW and pricing.
2) Forecast treatment: Laura, please keep DL-2027-089 as "best case / commit_pending" for the June/July forecast cut. We will only flip to "committed" once Redwood receives both a countersigned SOW and an issued PO.
3) Billing contact: Laura Bennett (finance@redwood.com) — please confirm if you want procurement to route POs to a billing mailbox or to a named AR contact.
4) Timing: AE to upload final SOW & PO by 2027-06-22 EOD. If both items arrive before forecast lock on 2027-06-24, we will move to committed in that cut; otherwise remain best-case.

Everyone, please shout if any of the timelines above are unrealistic. Appreciate the quick turnaround here — want to keep pipeline hygiene clean so the forecast isn't overstated.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
